$comment: THE app's data layer — PocketBase collections in PB's NATIVE import format (https://pocketbase.io/docs/collections). Declare collections here; the platform imports them into the app's PocketBase (single binary, SQLite) which then provides FULL REST CRUD itself: GET/POST /api/collections/<name>/records (?filter=, ?sort=-field, ?page/perPage, ?expand=rel), PATCH/DELETE /api/collections/<name>/records/<id>, realtime subscriptions, and file storage. Field names are used EXACTLY as declared (camelCase recommended — the same names appear in TypeScript types and the wire). Field types: text, number, bool, date, select (values[]), relation (collectionId or name via platform resolve), json, file, email, url, editor. 'id' + autodate 'created'/'updated' fields are automatic when declared with type autodate or via defaults. Rules: empty string = public (local single-user apps use "" for list/view/create/update/delete); null = superuser-only. Do NOT hand-create pb_data — the platform owns import/reset. Writing this file triggers re-import + regeneration of frontend/types.gen.ts. GOTCHA: required: true means NON-EMPTY — PB rejects false on a required bool, 0 on a required number, and '' on a required date/text ('cannot be blank'). Never mark fields required that legitimately start false/zero/empty; if a create fails 'cannot be blank' on a value you ARE sending, fix the schema (drop required), not the value.
